name: Măng vầu
summary: A bamboo shoot VOV lists with the grilled fish at Pac Ngoi. The species and the pickle were not printed there. Other publishers name forest bamboo, nứa, and trúc, and they do not say those shoots are măng vầu.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV, on Vietnam Tourism's rural desk.
howToEat: VOV names it on the house table and does not say how it is cooked. A season was not printed.

The Thái Nguyên portal says forest bamboo, măng rừng, can be stir-fried, boiled, cooked in soup, or dried for the year. Vietnam Tourism's ethnic desk names boiled forest bamboo. The rural desk's 2025 tea-country note names măng nứa beside crisp stream fish. VnExpress, in 2014, names măng trúc among the foods at a Pac Ngoi stay. None of them says the shoot is măng vầu.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Măng vầu is the bamboo shoot VOV lists at Pac Ngoi. How it is cooked is Check on arrival. Other bamboo names are not called the same shoot.
